plan: A fawn jungler who runs faster and faster and puts a whole team to sleep with her ultimate.
aSurveiller: Her R (Lilting Lullaby). Everyone she has hit falls asleep: don't stay grouped after getting hit.
contrer: After being hit by her spells, move away: her R puts you to sleep.
Dodge the centre of her W: it deals a huge amount of damage.
Slow her: her speed is her defence.
forces: Her R puts several enemies to sleep.

sorts.P: Her spells burn based on the target's max health.
sorts.W: Strike in the centre that hurts a lot.
sorts.R: Puts to sleep enemies hit by her spells.
